question.worked_solution:
Either the positive or negative of the expression inside the absolute value must be equal to the right-hand side of the equation.

So, we set up the two corresponding equations and solve them independently:

- If $|6x+1|=6x+1,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|6x+1| & =7 \\ 6x+1 & =7 \\ 6x & =6 \\ \frac{6x}{6} & =\frac{6}{6} \\ x & =1\end{aligned}
$$

- If $|6x+1|=-(6x+1),$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|6x+1| & =7 \\ -(6x+1) & =7 \\ -6x-1 & =7 \\ -6x & =8 \\ \frac{-6x}{-6} & =\frac{8}{-6} \\ x & =-\frac{4}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $x=-\frac{4}{3}$ and $x=1.$
